Image generation request routed through the proxy

```rust title="Rust"
use liter_llm::LlmClient;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() {
    let req_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"model":"dall-e-3","n":1,"prompt":"A sunset over the ocean","size":"1024x1024"}"#).unwrap();
    let req = serde_json::from_value(req_json).unwrap();
    let client = liter_llm::create_client(std::env::var("API_KEY").expect("API_KEY must be set"), None, None, None, None).unwrap();
    let result = client.image_generate(req).await.expect("call failed");
    println!("{:?}", result.data);
    println!("{:?}", result.data[0].url);
}
```
